summary: Mostly no. Breakouts above resistance and breaks below support did no better than random candles on 1h, 4h or daily. One result holds up, on 1h: after price crossed up through support, it was 0.38% ahead of random entries 20 candles later, and the gap held without its strongest stretch.

verdicts.use: Buying a bounce up through support
verdicts.text: On 1h, price beat random entries by 0.38% after 20 candles and again at 50 candles. On 4h and daily it was inside the luck band.
Inside the luck band on 1h, 4h and daily, in both versions. The 5-bar version on daily beat random only because of SOL's signals between Aug 6 and Aug 27, 2021.
On 1h it did 0.19% worse than random after 20 candles, and only at that horizon. Price did not keep falling after the break more than it does after a random candle.
No better than random entries on 1h, 4h or daily.

notes: On 1h, price crossing up through support gave 1,765 entries in 980 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.38% ahead of random entries, above a luck band that tops out at 0.24%. The gap stays when you drop the strongest stretch, on Sep 17, 2021, and it shows again at 50 candles. It does not show at 10 or 100 candles.

No single pair carries that 1h result by itself. On ETH it falls inside the band. On BTC it rests on signals on Feb 28, 2022. On SOL it shows at 20 candles only. The result only appears when you pool the three pairs, so test it on your own pair before you rely on it.

The 1h bounce off support split by trend. In downtrends it beat random by 0.42%, held without its strongest stretch on Feb 24, 2022, and showed at 10, 20 and 50 candles. In uptrends it beat random by 0.39%, but only at 20 candles. The 5-bar version on 4h split the same way: 1.18% ahead in downtrends, with the gap holding at 10, 20 and 50 candles, while uptrends sat inside the band at -0.32%. Pooled, the 4h 5-bar version shows nothing.

Resistance breakouts showed nothing. On 1h the cross up through resistance landed at 0, and the 5-bar version fires about twice as often with the same result. On 4h, 0.63% sits inside a band reaching 0.71%. In 4h uptrends the 0.73% gap came only from signals between Aug 10 and Aug 12, 2021.

Shorting a break below support on 1h did 0.19% worse than random, just past the band's lower end of -0.18%. In uptrends it did 0.28% worse, and in downtrends it showed nothing. A break below support on 1h was not a reliable start of a drop. In uptrends price tended to recover. On daily, every setting has 30 to 112 episodes in total. Several regime and per-pair cells fall under the minimum and were never judged.

For a long bot on 1h, a cross up through support is a possible filter beside your other start conditions. Its effect is strongest when the pair is below its 200-day SMA. The gap is a fraction of a percent over 20 candles, so the take profit and DCA orders still do most of the work. This data gives you reasons to leave out resistance breakouts as a long start and support breaks as a short start.
